title: DeviceSettingsConfigurationObject
description:
* `WEBEX_CALLING_DEVICE_CONFIGURATION` - Devices which supports Webex Calling Device Settings Configuration.
 * `WEBEX_DEVICE_CONFIGURATION` - Devices which supports Webex Device Settings Configuration.
 * `WEBEX_CALLING_DYNAMIC_DEVICE_CONFIGURATION` - Devices which supports Webex Calling dynamic Settings Configuration.
 * `NONE` - Devices does not support any configuration.
